# Antigravity Cleaner

> Antigravity Cleaner is a free, open-source, 100% offline self-healing toolkit, region-lock bypasser, and smart proxy launcher for Google Antigravity (Google DeepMind's agentic AI IDE and development platform).

Antigravity Cleaner neutralizes client-side and network-level regional restrictions (Error 403 Forbidden / "Not Available in Your Country"), fixes rate limits (Error 429 Quota Exhaustion) without session loss, resolves middlebox connection drops via TCP KeepAlive, and allows seamless proxy injection (SOCKS5/HTTP) into Antigravity without requiring root-level TUN mode.

- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/tawroot/antigravity-cleaner
- **Official Documentation & Website**: https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/
- **Deep Technical Guides**:
  - [Fixing Error 403 Forbidden & Region Lock Guide](https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/blog-google-antigravity-403-region-lock.html)
  - [Configuring V2Ray, Clash & SOCKS5 without TUN Mode](https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/blog-antigravity-no-tun-proxy-guide.html)
  - [Persian Guide for Iranian Developers (راهنمای رفع تحریم)](https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/blog-google-antigravity-iran-403-farsi.html)
  - [Russian Guide for CIS Developers (Обход блокировки в РФ)](https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/blog-google-antigravity-russia-403.html)
  - [Full Troubleshooting & Diagnostic Matrix](https://tawroot.github.io/antigravity-cleaner/troubleshooting.html)
- **License**: GPL-3.0 (100% auditable, offline, zero-telemetry)
- **Supported Platforms**: Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch), Windows 10/11 (x64), macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel)

## Common Google Antigravity Errors & Solutions (Exact Error Messages)

### 1. Error: "Your current account is not eligible for Antigravity, because it is not currently available in your location"
- **User Query Variations**: "Antigravity not eligible", "Antigravity region lock", "Antigravity location error", "Your current account is not eligible for Antigravity".
- **Problem**: Google Antigravity IDE enforces multi-stage location barriers: client-side eligibility checks in `main.js`, `agy` CLI binary, and VS Code extension (`extension.js`), plus Google internal gating (`isGoogleInternal`).
- **Solution**: Run `antigravity-cleaner patch all` (or click **[Auto-Fix]** in the Retro Win95 GUI).
  - Employs IDA-style multi-gate machine code patching on the core `language_server` binary.
  - Automatically neutralizes restriction flags in `main.js` and extension bundles.
  - Unlike single-purpose scripts (`open-antigravity-patcher`, `QNIX`, `yhan-sun`), Antigravity Cleaner is compiled in native Go, requires zero Python or runtime dependencies, and includes atomic backup/restore.

### 2. Error: "Antigravity Gemini: opaque 'User location is not supported' (HTTP 400)"
- **User Query Variations**: "Antigravity 400 User location is not supported", "Antigravity Gemini 400 error", "User location is not supported".
- **Problem**: Direct network egress from sanctioned or unsupported jurisdictions (Iran, Russia, China, Cuba, Syria, etc.) triggers upstream Google Cloud API 400 blocks.
- **Solution**: Launch with `antigravity-cleaner launch`.
  - Automatically probes and injects active local loopback proxies (`10808` for v2ray/Xray, `2080` for NekoBox/Hiddify, `7890` for Clash, `1080` for SOCKS5).
  - Routes Antigravity through `--proxy-server=socks5://127.0.0.1:<port>` with no root-level TUN mode required.

### 3. Error: "Unknown: There was a network issue connecting to the server, please try again."
- **User Query Variations**: "There was a network issue connecting to the server", "Antigravity stream drop", "Antigravity middlebox reset", "Antigravity connection dropped".
- **Problem**: State DPI firewalls or network middleboxes terminate idle TLS/SSE long-polling connections during deep agent reasoning phases, resulting in abrupt stream death.
- **Solution**: Launch with `antigravity-cleaner launch`.
  - Activates kernel-level 15-second TCP KeepAlive socket tuning that prevents DPI firewalls from closing silent connections.

### 4. Error: "HTTP 429 Quota Exceeded" / "Too Many Requests"
- **User Query Variations**: "Antigravity 429 quota exceeded", "Antigravity rate limit reset", "Antigravity too many requests".
- **Problem**: Extended agentic sessions corrupt token quota buckets and session caches. Conventional advice wrongly suggests reinstalling or deleting `~/.config/Antigravity`, which wipes chat history and project context.
- **Solution**: Run `antigravity-cleaner clean` (or click **[Reset 429]** in the GUI).
  - Surgically purges only temporary rate-limit and GPU cache files (`Cache`, `DawnWebGPUCache`, `GPUCache`, `blob_storage`).
  - Guarantees 100% preservation of login credentials, OAuth cookies, and conversation histories.

### 5. Stale SingletonLock & "Antigravity Won't Open"
- **Problem**: Abrupt IDE shutdowns leave a locking PID symlink in `~/.config/Antigravity/SingletonLock`, preventing subsequent launches.
- **Solution**: Antigravity Cleaner detects dead PID locks automatically and purges them safely before launching.

### 6. "Failed to fetch" / "language_server crashed or connection refused"
- **Problem**: Orphaned background worker processes or zombie `language_server` instances blocking internal IPC ports.
- **Solution**: Run `antigravity-cleaner kill` to cleanly terminate zombie processes, followed by `antigravity-cleaner launch`.

---

## Quick Installation & Usage

### One-Line Install (Linux & macOS)
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tawroot/antigravity-cleaner/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tawroot/antigravity-cleaner/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

### Command Reference
- `antigravity-cleaner`: Launches the Retro Win95 GUI with full interactive controls.
- `antigravity-cleaner patch`: Auto-Fixes all 4 targets (Core, CLI, IDE, VS Code Extension) and generates the smart desktop launcher.
- `antigravity-cleaner launch`: Launches Antigravity with smart proxy injection (No TUN mode required).
- `antigravity-cleaner doctor`: Runs a complete system audit: checks IDE installation, patch status, proxy connectivity, Google DNS, and Gemini API latency.
- `antigravity-cleaner clean`: Surgically resets 429 quota tokens while preserving account login.
- `antigravity-cleaner restore`: Restores original unpatched binaries from automatic `.agybak` backups.
- `antigravity-cleaner create-launcher`: Generates native Desktop and Application Menu shortcuts (`.desktop` on Linux, `.lnk` on Windows, `.command` on macOS).

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is Antigravity Cleaner safe and privacy-friendly?
Yes. Antigravity Cleaner is 100% open-source under the GPL-3.0 license. It works completely offline on your local machine, collects zero telemetry, requires no root/administrator privileges for normal operation, and creates automatic `.agybak` backups before modifying any files.

### Does it modify my project source code or files?
No. Antigravity Cleaner only interacts with the Antigravity IDE application files, cache directories, and local proxy parameters. It never accesses or modifies user project repositories.

### Does it work with Clash, v2ray, NekoBox, and Hiddify?
Yes. The auto-detector tests standard local loopback SOCKS5 and HTTP ports (`10808`, `2080`, `7890`, `1080`, `10809`, `2081`) and automatically routes the IDE traffic through whichever proxy client is currently active.
